restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes: one unkeyed BLAKE3 chunk/block with flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT=11, length 64, counter 0, standard IV.

Deterministic closed-form construction from public IV constants; no search, no random coins, no stored precomputed collision as advice; the constant table holds only IV[0..7] and F as nine narrow words.

Columns: every column G0..G3 uses the same identity (Lemma 5, (C*,D*)=(0,-b)), so all four output B=C=0 and D=-b. Diagonals G4/G6 then see b=c=0, d=-IV7/-IV5; M uses x=d-a, y=-d (=IV7, IV5), and M' replaces only w9, w13 by ~d (Lemma 6'), making both diagonals output all-F so the feed-forward pairs (v0,v8),(v2,v10),(v5,v13),(v7,v15) cancel. No IV parity condition is required.

Implementation: because the column formula is uniform, the four columns run in parallel as 64-bit lanes (32-bit value + 32-bit guard gap) of 256-bit words using only 256-bit ADD/SUB/AND/OR/XOR/SHL/SHR (lane Lemmas S1-S3 in proof.md); lane masks, guards, IV packing and lane extraction are all charged. No rotate instruction of any width is used.

Charged work: straight-line program, two verification compressions (H=2), 8x32-bit digest equality and message-distinctness checks, program placement (1 op/instruction) and constant-table placement (2 ops/word), under collision-frontier-v5 with C=222. Ledger W = 2(LD+ALU+ST+V) + 2LD with V=37.

No chaining (every ADD/SUB result lane-masked before further arithmetic) and no rotation-AND elision anywhere. Primary stream (LD=9, ALU=63, 18 shared-buffer stores): W=272. Harshest stress row (LD=11, masked-SUB flip ALU=64, 32 stores): W=310.
